in_marathi.name: Jotin
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jotin हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jotin is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Jot’ which means ‘light’ or ‘lord’. In Hindu mythology, Jotin is considered the lord of the universe and the creator of all beings. This powerful name is believed to bestow wisdom, courage, and the ability to overcome obstacles.
